meta.name: team-composition-patterns
meta.description: Design optimal agent team compositions with sizing heuristics, preset configurations, and agent type selection. Use this skill when deciding how many agents to spawn for a task, when choosing between a review team versus a feature team versus a debug team, when selecting the correct subagent_type for each role to ensure agents have the tools they need, when configuring display modes (tmux, iTerm2, in-process) for a CI or local environment, or when building a custom team composition for a non-standard workflow such as a migration or security audit.

copy.tagline: 按任务自动搭配agent团队与角色
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要决定任务该用多少agent与哪些角色
copy.tagline_en: Automatically compose optimal agent teams for your tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to size agent teams and assign agent types to roles.

howto.what: 当任务需要多个AI助手协作时，Claude会按任务复杂度建议1至5名成员，从审查、调试、功能等预设团队中选择方案，并为每个角色指定合适的agent类型。也可帮你配置tmux、iTerm2等显示模式或设计自定义团队。
howto.when: 当你在安排多智能体团队，需要决定人数、选择预设团队或成员agent类型时触发；也可用于配置显示模式（tmux、iTerm2）等场景。

say.text: 帮我把这次变更配成3人审查团队，检查安全、性能、架构。
say.note: 使用Review Team预设，3个审查者。

say.text: 这个bug有多个可疑原因，请组建调试团队排查。
say.note: 使用Debug Team预设，3个调试者。

say.text: 为非标准流程设计一个4人自定义团队，带审查角色。

howto.what_en: When assembling multiple agents for a task, Claude picks team size from complexity, selects a preset team (review/debug/etc.), and assigns each role a subagent_type. It can also configure display mode or advise on custom teams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you decide how many agents to spawn, choose a preset team, or assign each role a subagent_type; also when configuring display modes (tmux/iTerm2) or custom teams.

say_en.text: Create a 3-person review team covering security, performance, architecture.
say_en.note: Uses the Review Team preset with 3 reviewers.

say_en.text: This bug may have several root causes; start a debug team to investigate.
say_en.note: Uses the Debug Team preset with 3 investigators.

say_en.text: For this migration, design a 4-person custom team with a reviewer.
say_en.note: Similar to the Migration Team preset.
